column1: # Judgement grouping map. Keyed by the ledger hash.
# Columns: hash, group, note. Unit: one prose line the ledger classes as a judgement.

# A line that cites a skill is sourced there, and no row is stored for it: --regroup derives its group as j-source-of-truth-<skill> and its note as skill:<skill>, so a stored row would be a copy of the derivation and fails.

# A line that cites no skill carries a row here. note is skill:<name> when the source of truth is a skill the line does not name, candidate[:<name>] for one document's judgement that should generalise, or - for a judgement that stays local.
# The scan set is the two source documents, so a judgement a convention skill also states counts one document here. Read a class-1 group with that limit.
